statements.status_notes: temporalio-admin-tools 1.28.x and 1.29.x embed go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.43.0 via published dhi/temporalio-server artifacts. debian-13 runtime packages are HSP-based, but these Go binaries still come from the server OCI artifact digests. The temporalio-server definition already bumps otel to 1.44.0; clearing this finding requires republished server images and a digest track update. From 1.30 onward admin-tools builds these binaries from source with golang-1.26 HSP packages and otel 1.44.0.

This OpenTelemetry module is embedded in /usr/bin/containerd from the current containerd.io package used by sbx-templates Docker variants. Remediation requires the upstream Docker containerd.io package to rebuild containerd with fixed OpenTelemetry module versions.
